header.name: Maya Iyer
header.subtagline: Payments infrastructure, distributed systems, and developer tooling

summary: Senior Software Engineer who builds and runs payment-platform services at scale. I own services end to end, from API design through on-call, and I care most about latency and clear failure modes. I cut our checkout **p99 by 45%** and I like turning flaky systems into boring ones.

experience.summary: I own the checkout and settlement services that move money for millions of users, from API design through production on-call.
bullets: Rebuilt the settlement service in Go and cut **p99 latency** from 820ms to 450ms, a **45%** drop, with batched writes and a read-through Redis cache.
Designed a **Kafka** event pipeline that now carries **12B+** events a day with at-least-once delivery and idempotent consumers.
Took payments uptime to **99.98%** with circuit breakers, bulkheads, and a chaos test suite that runs in CI.
Cut deploy time from 30 minutes to 4 after I split the monolith build and parallelized the test stage.
Mentored 4 engineers and ran the design-review process, which lifted our first-pass approval rate to **80%**.

experience.summary: Worked on the metrics platform that the rest of engineering used to watch their services.
bullets: Built the metrics ingestion API in Java and scaled it to **2M** writes per second with backpressure and sharded storage.
Shipped a self-serve dashboard builder that **300+** internal teams adopted in its first quarter.
Reduced storage cost by **38%** with a tiered retention policy and column compression.

experience.summary: Built an internal log-search tool in Python that saved the support team about 200 hours a quarter.

projects.name: OpenTrace
projects.subtitle: Distributed tracing toolkit
projects.blurb: An open-source OpenTelemetry helper that **1.2k+** GitHub stars and a dozen contributors now use.
bullets: Cut trace overhead to under **2%** with tail sampling and async export.
Added drop-in adapters for Go, Python, and Java so teams ship tracing in an afternoon.

projects.blurb: A benchmark suite for double-entry ledgers that compares 6 databases on one identical workload.
